image_pattern_summary: Verified good security cabin images consistently show the complete cabin structure from an exterior angle — door, window(s), and roof all visible — photographed in a fabrication yard, open field, or real deployment context. Most units are compact (4×4 to 6×8 ft footprint) with pyramid or sloped roofs, painted in two-tone colours (blue/white, grey/teal). Some listings add buyer value by showing interior fitments (tiled floor, sliding window counter, electrical points) or real installation context (gate entry with barrier arm).

reason: Security cabins are physical structures whose key buyer signals (size, construction quality, door/window placement, roof type, colour) are conveyed entirely through visual appearance — OCR cannot extract these from the product image.

Verified good images show complete cabin exteriors and interiors; no meaningful text is printed on the product surface that would yield useful OCR data (brand stickers are incidental, not product-defining).
Buyers evaluate security cabins by visual inspection of the structure — material finish, panel quality, window size, and overall build — making the image itself the primary information carrier.
